name: Ashwood Bow
summary: Quest choice: Crown of the Earth #935 — Corithras Moonrage, Dolanaar → Fandral Staghelm, Darnassus (published; current eligibility/chain unverified).
details:
Final published reward step #935: take the provided Filled Vessel #5188 from Corithras Moonrage to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus, and choose Ashwood Bow (alternative Thicket Hammer). Corithras Moonrage (NPC #3515); published map footprint Teldrassil x 56.2–56.2, y 61.4–61.6. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm (NPC #3516); published map footprint Darnassus x 34.4–34.8, y 8.4–8.8.
Published chain: Tenaron's Summons #920, Gilshalan Windwalker → Tenaron Stormgrip atop Aldrassil/Shadowglen; #921 fill the Crystal Phial at the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return to Tenaron; #928 deliver the Partially Filled Vessel to Corithras in Dolanaar; #929 fill the Jade Phial at Starbreeze Village's moonwell; #933 fill the Tourmaline Phial at Pools of Arlithrien southeast of Darnassus; #7383 fill the Amethyst Phial at Oracle Glade northwest; return to Corithras between water tasks, then #935 deliver the final vessel to Fandral. Gilshalan Windwalker (NPC #2082); published map footprint Teldrassil x 57.8–57.8, y 41.6–41.6. Tenaron Stormgrip (NPC #3514); published map footprint Teldrassil x 59–59, y 39.4–39.4.
